correctness.rationale: Rotation conjugation yields L_j=Q^j L_0 Q^{-j}, and L_0 Q is the explicitly verified lower triangular K. Since Q^m=-I, M=-K^m, exact triangular powers supply every eigenvalue and iteration. Eigenvalues lie within the unit disk and imply unique affine fixed points. For λ<1, the nonzero shear maps unit e1 to a vector with strictly larger norm than c^{mk}; λ=1 has norm c^{mk}. Standalone reconstructed maps passed 5528 finite checks but infinite claims depend on proof.

value.rationale: The motivating cyclic relaxation is designed for inconsistent feasibility, and this natural maximally symmetric m-line case tests how its regularization affects true linear convergence. The exact result separates parameter-invariant spectral rate from strictly worse finite-horizon nonnormal amplification and supplies a sharp reference family for future generic angle or parameter-dependent rate analyses.
